##### ClinVar's sources for functional consequence terms include Sequence Ontology (SO) and Functional Epilepsy Nomenclature for Ion Channels (FENICS).
##### SO terms are generally applicable to all variants. However, not all terms from SO are used by ClinVar for functional consequence. Contact us at clinvar@ncbi.nlm.nih.gov to discuss allowing a new SO term in ClinVar or adding new term to SO to support ClinVar submissions.
##### FENICS terms are specifically for electrophysiology experiments on ion channels in the context of neurological disorders, in particular epilepsy.
Term	ID	Source
abolished transcription	SO:0002391	Sequence Ontology
absent gene product	SO:0002317	Sequence Ontology
absent protein	SO:0002395	Sequence Ontology
activated cryptic splice donor	SO:0001571	Sequence Ontology
Abnormal ion selectivity	FENICS-0080	Functional Epilepsy Nomenclature for Ion Channels
Absence of abnormal gating pore current	FENICS-0076	Functional Epilepsy Nomenclature for Ion Channels
